Title: Azure Monitor’s Baseline and CalculateBaseline APIs will be retired on 30 November 2021

Body.Content:
Because Azure Monitor now provides a unified and improved MetricBaselines API for retrieving Dynamic Thresholds baselines for Azure metrics, the legacy Baseline and CalculateBaseline APIs will be retired on 30 November 2021.

To get the Dynamic Thresholds baselines (upper and lower bounds) for your Azure resource metrics, please use the MetricBaselines API.
